question: Name the initiative launched to empower elected women representatives from Panchayati Raj institutions:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Panchayat Se Parliament 2.0**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Panchayat Se Parliament 2.0** programme was inaugurated by Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan, New Delhi.
 
• The initiative focuses on empowering **elected women representatives** from Scheduled Tribes in Panchayati Raj institutions.
 
• It aims to enhance their understanding of **constitutional provisions, parliamentary procedures, and governance**.
 
• The programme seeks to foster **effective leadership** among women at the grassroots level to drive social and economic empowerment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panchayati Raj Institutions:** These local self-governance bodies play a crucial role in the development of villages and implementation of government schemes.
 
• **Participation:** Around 500 elected women representatives from 20 states and union territories participated in the programme.
 
• **Objective:** The programme aligns with the vision of a **self-reliant India (Atmanirbhar Bharat)** by empowering women to take leadership roles in governance.
 
• **Role of Women:** Women associated with Panchayats contribute to social and economic empowerment by disseminating the benefits of central government schemes at the grassroots level.
